original.prompt: In September 2026, the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) issued a mandate on mobile tariff plans. Consider the following statements about it:
items: It requires operators to offer more voice-and-text-only prepaid plans at reduced tariffs.
Operators must offer such an option matching every validity period of 90 days or less in their bundled voice, text and data plans.
Operators must also provide a calendar-month renewal option and at least one longer-duration plan.
original.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
original.explain: Statement 2 is wrong because the matching requirement covers every validity period of 30 days or less, not 90 days. The rules target low-income consumers and those who do not need mobile data, who had limited short-term choices.
original.source: Operators must offer an option matching every validity period of 30 days or less in their bundled voice, text, and data plans, alongside a calendar-month renewal option and at least one longer-duration plan.
